title: Looking for feedback on my new Android card game: Speed Rush
author: Round_Payment8069
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm an indie dev and I've just released my new game, Speed Rush. It’s a fast-paced take on the classic Speed card game, optimized for mobile.

Think you're fast enough? ⚡ Put your reflexes to the test with Speed Rush, the ultimate fast-paced card game. Play now and see if you can clear your hand before the clock runs out!

I’d love for you to check it out and let me know what you think. Any feedback or suggestions are highly appreciated!

A note on development: As an indie developer, I've been experimenting with AI tools throughout the creation of this game. From generating UI concepts and optimizing code logic in TypeScript to refining the game's mechanics, AI has been an incredible collaborator in speeding up my workflow and helping me bring "Speed Rush" to life as a solo dev. It's been an interesting journey, and I’m happy to answer any questions about the dev process!

​Download here:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.avgames.speedrush
